source: Owner directive 2026-10-18: eyes must be swappable Tekken/WWE-style. Every variant saved, never overwritten.

coordinate_system.pixel_space: x right, y DOWN, origin top-left of the PNG as stored in the GLB
coordinate_system.uv_space: Both eye meshes share the FULL texture: u=[0,1], v=[0,1]. Iris is centered, pupil at center.

canonical_eye_placement.description: The whole King_Eye_D texture maps onto each eyeball. Iris circle is centered in the texture; pupil at the texture center. Any eye option is a drop-in 128x128 replacement.
canonical_eye_placement.notes: Both eyes (left/right) share this UV region, so one PNG covers both eyes.

entries.name: Eyes - yellow tiger / snow leopard (realistic)
entries.notes: CURRENTLY APPLIED on Attire 3. Realistic golden-yellow feline iris: radial fiber striations, dark limbal ring, deep amber peripupillary ring, round black pupil (accurate for tigers/snow leopards), specular highlight. Painted 2026-10-18 per owner order.

entries.name: Eyes - snow leopard blue (Attire 3 default)
entries.notes: The blue eyes from the 2026-10-17 snow-leopard reskin (recolored from yellow). Saved as the snow-leopard BLUE default option per owner 2026-10-18. Drop-in swap restores them exactly.

entries.name: Eyes - original classic yellow
entries.notes: Pantera's ORIGINAL classic yellow eyes (pre-reskin), extracted from roster/pantera/attires/classic/pantera-classic.glb. Byte-identical to the Attire 1 (pantera-t7king) eyes. Drop-in swap restores them exactly.

how_to_swap: 2. Re-embed it as image 5 (King_Eye_D, Modeleyes_Material003 baseColor) in roster/pantera/attires/snow-leopard/pantera-snow-leopard.glb.
3. To restore the current look: re-embed eye-yellow-tiger.png. For the blue snow-leopard default: eye-snow-leopard-blue.png.
